faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT), Kolkata Campus, for filling up administrative and operational roles on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post for recruitment is Lady hostel superintendent, designated for managing hostel facilities and maintaining discipline on the IIFT Kolkata campus.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Lady hostel superintendent post under this current recruitment notification released by IIFT.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIFT Lady hostel superintendent recruitment is 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institution along with relevant administrative experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is experience required for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need a minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in hostel management, residential facility management, or institutional administration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is preferably between 30 and 50 years, ensuring mature and capable handling of institutional hostel responsibilities.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between Rs. 30,000/- and Rs. 35,000/- per month depending on suitability.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official IIFT website and submitting their applications before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting of applications followed by an interview and/or a skill test conducted by the competent authority.
